name: dev-agents
description: Eleven subagents with the model tier bound per role, so read-only exploration runs on haiku, real design judgement runs on opus, and a gated last resort runs on fable for a problem the opus tier has already failed to solve. Includes a delegation strategy skill that says which agent to pick and how to brief it, plus five reminder hooks: one when the main thread has been grinding alone too long, a pair that asks for a task plan before a subagent is dispatched so a long run plus context compaction cannot lose your remaining steps, one that reads what the dispatch actually returned, so an interrupted, empty or blocked subagent is not mistaken for a finished one, and one that prints the four preconditions before the last resort is allowed to cost you anything. Does NOT replace /model opusplan for getting code implementation onto a cheaper tier; see the skill.
